name: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation
summary: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation, incorporated in 2000 and headquartered in Shanghai, is an investment holding company that designs, makes, tests, packages and sells integrated circuits to customers in North America, China, wider Asia and Eurasia. It also develops and sells semiconductor masks, offers foundry and technology services, and runs residential accommodation. It supports clients with design, intellectual property and photomask production, as well as marketing and private education.
